messages:
zoe: async check-in — SDK / quickstarts / samples

what I did: published python-sdk v0.9.2, updated quickstart README (auth example + code snippets). pushed a small docs tweak to the quickstart branch.
blocker: sample-chat (js) segfaults on mac M1 when running dev server (node 18.16, npm run dev). suspect native dep.
today: debug sample-chat, open a minimal repro PR, request reviews for docs snippet and sample fix.

mike: can you paste the exact error output? I can try to repro on my M1 later.

zoe: error paste: ```bash
node: ../src/node_crypto.cc:123: Assertion `args[0]->IsString()' failed.
FATAL ERROR: v8::ToLocalChecked() 
 1: 0x108f3d3d1 node::Abort()
 2: 0x108f3d469  
 3: 0x108f3d7b6  
```
Not super helpful — looks like a native build or binary mismatch (esbuild/native?).

sasha: i hit something like this last week — esbuild binary can blow up on M1 if installed with the wrong prebuilt. try: `npm rebuild esbuild` or set `ESBUILD_BINARY_PATH` to force the correct binary. also check `node-gyp` rebuild logs.

zoe: trying `npm rebuild esbuild` now... ok that removed the segfault but app errors with `Error: Cannot find module './native'` when importing the runtime glue. pushed a tiny repro PR: https://github.com/redwood/sample-chat/pull/12 — added minimal steps to reproduce, logs and stack. PTAL @kai

kai: looking now, will comment. if it's esbuild related we can pin to esbuild@0.17.x in package.json as a short-term mitigation. happy to approve the docs fixes after a quick sanity check.

mike: quick heads-up — I also noticed the quickstart auth snippet was pointing at `/v1/old-key-route`. I pushed a tiny correction to the docs branch: https://github.com/redwood/docs/commit/abcd1234 — please verify before release notes.

sasha: i can review the docs commit after design review wraps. sounds low priority but we should not ship the wrong endpoint.

docs-bot: CI update — latest docs build passed at 12:03 UTC, snapshot tests: :white_check_mark: , full build: green.

zoe: summary / asks: blocker: need reviewer for sample-chat PR #12, need someone to confirm quickstart auth snippet (mike already opened fix). otherwise i'll continue packaging release notes and tagging the SDK. thanks! :rocket:
